title: [Feature Request]: Support base_url for Anthropic Provider
body:
### Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.

It's essential to set base_url for both Anthropic and Anthropic Bedrock when we need to proxy the api calls.

The current version of AnthropicClient ignored base_url parameter from config list.

### Describe the solution you'd like

_No response_

_No response_
